review_comments.body: I'm not sure why it creates a new class here instead of just putting it above, but it's fine.

Ahhh.  Claude told me why. but it's fine the way it is:

The separate class exists only because setup in Toolbox::GmailTest calls skip, which would skip the new test too. A cleaner fix is to move skip out of setup and into the email_myself test. Then setup only builds @gmail, and the empty-mailbox test can go in the main class and use @gmail. No second class is needed.
